description: Differential-drive rover (the ev03-harness rover), commanded with {linear, angular} velocities. The limits are the drive's top speeds: 1.5 m/s forward and back, 1.5 rad/s either way; the harness's normalised actuator unit 1.0 is these limits. malformed is left out: the commands are in-memory Python mappings, which carry every malformed kind.

far_targets.description: Straight ahead at top speed, no steering: the harness rover fuzzer's drive_out, which tries to leave the workspace.
